# go-libs (github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs@v0.6.0)

> 41 focused, production-hardened Go packages (Go 1.26.0, 100.0% statement coverage) covering HTTP/Gin & zero-Gin stdlib `httpmw` middleware, SSE streaming, ETag/version-gated caching, loopback CSRF guards, resilience & concurrency, PostgreSQL & embedded SQLite WAL helpers, observability, security & RBAC, and foundational type-safe utilities.

`go-libs` uses a single-module Bill of Materials (BOM) architecture (`github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs@v0.6.0`) with zero business domain logic. Every package is independently importable; 29 Depth-0 pure internal leaf packages have zero internal `go-libs` imports, and 35 minimal-footprint leaf packages (`apperror`, `async`, `bodylimit`, `cache`, `circuitbreaker`, `clock`, `compress`, `cryptoutil`, `env`, `etag`, `fsm`, `health`, `httpmw`, `httputil`, `jwks`, `logger`, `loopbackguard`, `maputil`, `metrics`, `pagination`, `ratelimit`, `rbac`, `rbaccontext`, `requestid`, `retry`, `securityheaders`, `shutdown`, `sliceutil`, `sqlite`, `sse`, `stringutil`, `timeutil`, `uuidutil`, `validation`, `workerpool`) never pull heavy third-party frameworks (`gin`, `pgx`, or `opentelemetry`) into downstream consumer binaries.

## Quick Installation

```bash
# Install Go module (requires Go 1.26.0+)
go get github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs@v0.6.0

# Install AI Agent Skills (Antigravity, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor)
npx skills add abeta-dev/go-libs
```

## 41-Package Catalog & Primary Exported APIs

### 1. Resilience, Concurrency & Runtime Infrastructure (10 Packages)

- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/retry` (`@v0.6.0`): Context-aware backoff and retry execution algorithms with non-retryable error classification.
  - Exports: `retry.Do`, `retry.DoWithResult[T]`, `retry.Config`, `retry.Constant`, `retry.Linear`, `retry.Exponential`, `retry.ExponentialJitter`, `retry.MarkPermanent`, `retry.IsPermanent`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/circuitbreaker` (`@v0.6.0`): Outbound 3-state (`Closed`, `Open`, `HalfOpen`) failure state machine.
  - Exports: `circuitbreaker.ConsecutiveBreaker`, `circuitbreaker.RatioBreaker`, `circuitbreaker.NewConsecutiveBreaker`, `circuitbreaker.NewRatioBreaker`, `Execute`, `State`, `ErrCircuitOpen`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/ratelimit` (`@v0.6.0`): In-memory and PostgreSQL rate limiters (Token Bucket & Sliding Window) with CIDR trusted-proxy parsing and RFC `RateLimit-*` HTTP headers.
  - Exports: `ratelimit.New`, `ratelimit.NewTokenBucket`, `ratelimit.NewSlidingWindow`, `ratelimit.NewPGRateLimiter`, `ratelimit.NewGlobal`, `ratelimit.NewAuth`, `TokenBucketLimiter`, `SlidingWindowLimiter`, `WithMetrics`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/workerpool` (`@v0.6.0`): Bounded panic-safe concurrent worker pool with graceful queue draining and metrics hooks.
  - Exports: `workerpool.Pool`, `workerpool.New`, `Submit`, `SubmitContext`, `Stop`, `WithMetrics`, `WithPanicHandler`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/cache` (`@v0.6.0`): Generic singleflight stampede-protected multi-policy in-memory cache with prefix/tag invalidation and fetch status reporting.
  - Exports: `cache.TypedCache[T]`, `cache.NewTypedCache[T]`, `cache.NewMemoryCache`, `Get`, `Set`, `Delete`, `GetOrFetch`, `GetOrFetchWithStatus`, `GetOrFetchWithTags`, `DeletePrefix`, `SetWithTags`, `InvalidateTag`, `InvalidateTags`, `FetchStatus`, `FetchStatusHit`, `FetchStatusMiss`, `FetchStatusCoalesced`, `InvalidatingCache`, `WithEvictionPolicy`, `WithMetrics`, `WithEvictionInterval`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/async` (`@v0.6.0`): Panic-safe goroutines and bounded concurrency orchestration.
  - Exports: `async.Go`, `async.GoCtx`, `async.Parallel`, `async.ParallelLimit`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/shutdown` (`@v0.6.0`): Coordinated concurrent graceful teardown manager for OS signals (`SIGINT`, `SIGTERM`).
  - Exports: `shutdown.Manager`, `shutdown.New`, `Register`, `Execute`, `Wait`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/fsm` (`@v0.6.0`): Declarative in-memory finite state machine with O(1) transitions.
  - Exports: `fsm.Machine`, `fsm.NewMachine`, `Transition`, `CanTransition`, `ValidateTransition`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/clock` (`@v0.6.0`): Deterministic mockable time abstraction for sleep-free unit tests.
  - Exports: `clock.Clock`, `clock.RealClock`, `clock.FakeClock`, `clock.NewReal`, `clock.NewFake`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/metrics` (`@v0.6.0`): Framework-agnostic instrumentation interfaces with zero-allocation no-op defaults.
  - Exports: `metrics.Counter`, `metrics.Gauge`, `metrics.Histogram`, `metrics.NoopCounter`, `metrics.NoopGauge`, `metrics.NoopHistogram`.

### 2. HTTP Transport, Edge Middleware, Streaming & Gin/Stdlib Pipelines (16 Packages)

- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/ginmw` (`@v0.6.0`): Unified Gin HTTP middleware suite (31 production helpers).
  - Exports: `ginmw.AuthMiddleware`, `ginmw.GenerateToken`, `ginmw.GetClaims`, `ginmw.Compress`, `ginmw.PrecompressedFileServer`, `ginmw.PrecompressedFS`, `ginmw.ETag`, `ginmw.WriteVersionedJSON`, `ginmw.LoopbackGuard`, `ginmw.NewLoopbackGuard`, `ginmw.SSE`, `ginmw.RBAC`, `ginmw.RequirePermission`, `ginmw.RequireAnyPermission`, `ginmw.AdminOnly`, `ginmw.CORS`, `ginmw.GlobalRateLimit`, `ginmw.AuthRateLimit`, `ginmw.LimitBodyDefault`, `ginmw.LimitBodyAuth`, `ginmw.SecurityHeaders`, `ginmw.SecurityHeadersWithOptions`, `ginmw.RequestID`, `ginmw.Logger`, `ginmw.Telemetry`, `ginmw.Idempotency`, `ginmw.RequireTenant`, `ginmw.RespondSuccess`, `ginmw.RespondError`, `ginmw.REDMetrics`, `ginmw.MetricsEndpoint`, `ginmw.ErrorHandler`, `ginmw.Recovery`, `ginmw.RateLimit`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/httpmw` (`@v0.6.0`): Zero-Gin, zero-pgx, zero-OTel stdlib `net/http` middleware suite for lightweight and desktop `.dmg` BFFs.
  - Exports: `httpmw.Chain`, `httpmw.Use`, `httpmw.RequestID`, `httpmw.LimitBody`, `httpmw.LimitBodyDefault`, `httpmw.LimitBodyAuth`, `httpmw.Compress`, `httpmw.PrecompressedFileServer`, `httpmw.PrecompressedFS`, `httpmw.ETag`, `httpmw.SecurityHeaders`, `httpmw.LoopbackGuard`, `httpmw.CORS`, `httpmw.CORSWithConfig`, `httpmw.Recovery`, `httpmw.Logger`, `httpmw.MetricsTracker`, `httpmw.DefaultMetrics`, `httpmw.REDMetrics`, `httpmw.MetricsEndpoint`, `httpmw.RateLimit`, `httpmw.GlobalRateLimit`, `httpmw.AuthRateLimit`, `httpmw.RequirePermission`, `httpmw.RequireAnyPermission`, `httpmw.RequireTenant`, `httpmw.WithTenantContext`, `httpmw.TenantIDFromContext`, `httpmw.SSE`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/compress` (`@v0.6.0`): SSE-safe RFC 9110 Brotli (`br`) & Gzip (`gzip`) response compression, bounded request decompression, and precompressed `.br`/`.gz` SPA file server with `<meta>` CSRF token injection.
  - Exports: `compress.Middleware`, `compress.Negotiate`, `compress.Config`, `compress.DefaultConfig`, `compress.PrecompressedFileServer`, `compress.PrecompressedFS`, `compress.WithSPAFallback`, `compress.WithFallbackExcludePrefixes`, `compress.WithCSRFMetaToken`, `compress.WithCSRFMetaTokenProvider`, `compress.WithImmutableCacheControl`, `compress.EncodingBrotli`, `compress.EncodingGzip`, `compress.EncodingIdentity`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/etag` (`@v0.6.0`): RFC 9110 `ETag` / `If-None-Match` (`304 Not Modified`) and version-gated JSON middleware with volatile JSON key stripping and `X-Client-App-Version` auto-bust.
  - Exports: `etag.Middleware`, `etag.Compute`, `etag.Match`, `etag.WriteVersionedJSON`, `etag.WithAppVersion`, `etag.WithPageVersion`, `etag.WithIgnoreJSONKeys`, `etag.WithCacheControl`, `etag.WithWeak`, `etag.WithClientVersionHeader`, `etag.WithMaxBufferBytes`, `etag.WithMethods`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/loopbackguard` (`@v0.6.0`): Local-first loopback address validator, DNS-rebinding `Host` allowlist, `Sec-Fetch-Site` / `Origin` Same-Origin guard, and constant-time per-boot ephemeral CSRF middleware.
  - Exports: `loopbackguard.ValidateLoopbackAddr`, `loopbackguard.GenerateCSRFToken`, `loopbackguard.Guard`, `loopbackguard.New`, `WithAllowedHosts`, `WithAllowedOrigins`, `WithCSRFToken`, `WithCSRFHeader`, `WithDisableCSRF`, `WithSafeMethods`, `WithExemptPaths`, `WithStrictSecFetchSite`, `WithRequireLoopbackPeer`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/sse` (`@v0.6.0`): First-class Server-Sent Events (`text/event-stream`) streaming helper with flushing, heartbeat keepalives, `Last-Event-ID`, and clean context cancellation.
  - Exports: `sse.Stream`, `sse.Event`, `sse.NewStream`, `sse.Handler`, `sse.WithHeartbeat`, `sse.WithHeartbeatComment`, `sse.WithRetry`, `sse.WithHeaders`, `sse.ErrStreamingUnsupported`, `sse.ErrStreamClosed`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/httpclient` (`@v0.6.0`): Resilient composed HTTP client chaining RateLimiter -> CircuitBreaker -> Retry -> Per-Attempt Timeout -> Transport.
  - Exports: `httpclient.New`, `httpclient.NewRoundTripper`, `WithRetry`, `WithCircuitBreaker`, `WithRateLimiter`, `WithPerAttemptTimeout`, `WithHeader`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/httputil` (`@v0.6.0`): Standardized JSON response writers, CORS middleware, and domain error status mapping for `net/http`.
  - Exports: `httputil.OK`, `httputil.Created`, `httputil.NoContent`, `httputil.Error`, `httputil.ErrorFromDomain`, `httputil.ValidationError`, `httputil.CORS`, `httputil.DefaultCORSConfig`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/pagination` (`@v0.6.0`): Clamped offset and cursor pagination query parsers, generic slice pagination, and typed response envelopes.
  - Exports: `pagination.Parse`, `pagination.Offset`, `pagination.NewResponse`, `pagination.NewTypedResponse[T]`, `pagination.PaginateSlice[T]`, `pagination.ParseCursor`, `pagination.EncodeCursor`, `pagination.DecodeCursor`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/idempotency` (`@v0.6.0`): Two-phase atomic HTTP request deduplication with in-memory and PostgreSQL backing stores.
  - Exports: `idempotency.Store`, `idempotency.MemoryStore`, `idempotency.PGStore`, `idempotency.NewMemoryStore`, `idempotency.NewPGStore`, `idempotency.Middleware`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/health` (`@v0.6.0`): Parallel dependency health check aggregator and Kubernetes liveness/readiness HTTP probe handlers.
  - Exports: `health.Service`, `health.New`, `health.WithChecker`, `LivenessHandler`, `ReadinessHandler`, `Handler`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/requestid` (`@v0.6.0`): W3C correlation ID (`X-Request-ID`) generator, HTTP middleware, and context propagator.
  - Exports: `requestid.Middleware`, `requestid.FromContext`, `requestid.Header`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/recovery` (`@v0.6.0`): Panic-to-JSON-500 `net/http` middleware with structured `slog` stack logging and OpenTelemetry span error recording.
  - Exports: `recovery.Middleware`, `recovery.WithLogger`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/securityheaders` (`@v0.6.0`): OWASP defensive HTTP header middleware (`Content-Security-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Frame-Options`, `X-Content-Type-Options`) with local-first `WithDisableHSTS()` and `WithCacheControl(...)`.
  - Exports: `securityheaders.New`, `securityheaders.Default`, `securityheaders.WithDisableHSTS`, `securityheaders.WithCacheControl`, `securityheaders.WithCSP`, `securityheaders.WithServerName`, `securityheaders.WithHSTSMaxAge`, `securityheaders.WithPermissionsPolicy`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/bodylimit` (`@v0.6.0`): HTTP request body byte-limit middleware preventing payload inflation attacks.
  - Exports: `bodylimit.New`, `bodylimit.MB`, `bodylimit.KB`, `bodylimit.String`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/validation` (`@v0.6.0`): Human-readable `go-playground/validator/v10` struct validation error formatter.
  - Exports: `validation.FormatErrors`, `validation.FieldError`.

### 3. Data Access, Security, RBAC & Observability (8 Packages)

- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/db` (`@v0.6.0`): PostgreSQL `pgxpool` connection lifecycle, `DBTX` / `TxBeginner` interfaces, and context-propagated transactional execution.
  - Exports: `db.Connect`, `db.WithTx`, `db.WithQuerier`, `db.GetQuerier`, `db.DBTX`, `db.TxBeginner`, `db.WithMaxConns`, `db.WithMinConns`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/sqlite` (`@v0.6.0`): Zero-dependency, driver-agnostic embedded SQLite WAL helper over `database/sql` with `busy_timeout`, `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` write transactions, `PRAGMA user_version` migrations, WAL checkpointing, and atomic `VACUUM INTO` backups.
  - Exports: `sqlite.Open`, `sqlite.Wrap`, `sqlite.DB`, `sqlite.Querier`, `sqlite.WithQuerier`, `sqlite.GetQuerier`, `sqlite.Migration`, `sqlite.MigrationResult`, `sqlite.CheckpointMode`, `sqlite.CheckpointStats`, `sqlite.SynchronousMode`, `sqlite.WithDriver`, `sqlite.WithBusyTimeout`, `sqlite.WithSynchronous`, `sqlite.WithJournalMode`, `sqlite.WithForeignKeys`, `sqlite.WithCacheSizeKB`, `sqlite.WithMaxOpenConns`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/rbac` (`@v0.6.0`): Multi-segment wildcard Role-Based Access Control policy evaluator.
  - Exports: `rbac.Engine`, `rbac.NewEngine`, `Match`, `HasPermission`, `HasAnyPermission`, `HasAllPermissions`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/rbaccontext` (`@v0.6.0`): Context-bound permission injection and lookup helpers.
  - Exports: `rbaccontext.WithPermissions`, `rbaccontext.Permissions`, `rbaccontext.Can`, `rbaccontext.CanAny`, `rbaccontext.CanAll`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/jwks` (`@v0.6.0`): Thread-safe cached ECDSA P-256 JWKS public key resolver with stale-key fallback on upstream outage.
  - Exports: `jwks.Resolver`, `jwks.NewResolver`, `jwks.GetECPublicKey`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/cryptoutil` (`@v0.6.0`): Bcrypt password hashing (OWASP cost 12) and CSPRNG temporary password generation.
  - Exports: `cryptoutil.HashPassword`, `cryptoutil.ComparePassword`, `cryptoutil.IsCorrectPassword`, `cryptoutil.GenerateTempPassword`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/telemetry` (`@v0.6.0`): OpenTelemetry distributed tracing provider setup and W3C trace context span helpers.
  - Exports: `telemetry.NewTracerProvider`, `telemetry.InitProvider`, `telemetry.StartSpan`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/logger` (`@v0.6.0`): Request-context aware structured `slog` logger with PII field redaction and log sampling.
  - Exports: `logger.Default`, `logger.FromContext`, `logger.WithContext`, `logger.WithField`, `logger.WithFields`, `logger.NewRedactingHandler`, `logger.NewSamplingHandler`.

### 4. Foundational Type-Safe Utilities & Domain Errors (7 Packages)

- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/apperror` (`@v0.6.0`): Canonical structured domain error hierarchy mapping cleanly to HTTP status codes with `errors.Is` support.
  - Exports: `apperror.Error`, `apperror.Code`, `apperror.New`, `apperror.Wrap`, `apperror.Is`, `apperror.BadRequest`, `apperror.Unauthorized`, `apperror.Forbidden`, `apperror.NotFound`, `apperror.Conflict`, `apperror.Internal`, `CodeBadRequest`, `CodeUnauthorized`, `CodeForbidden`, `CodeNotFound`, `CodeConflict`, `CodeInternal`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/uuidutil` (`@v0.6.0`): Centralized RFC 4122 / RFC 9562 UUID v4 and time-ordered UUID v7 generation and validation.
  - Exports: `uuidutil.New`, `uuidutil.NewString`, `uuidutil.NewV7`, `uuidutil.NewV7String`, `uuidutil.Parse`, `uuidutil.ParsePtr`, `uuidutil.MustParse`, `uuidutil.IsValid`, `uuidutil.IsNil`, `uuidutil.Nil`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/env` (`@v0.6.0`): Zero-dependency typed OS environment variable parsers with fallback defaults and panic-on-missing `Must*` variants.
  - Exports: `env.String`, `env.Int`, `env.Bool`, `env.Duration`, `env.MustString`, `env.MustInt`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/sliceutil` (`@v0.6.0`): Generic slice transformations and functional aggregators beyond standard library `slices`.
  - Exports: `sliceutil.Reduce`, `sliceutil.GroupBy`, `sliceutil.Chunk`, `sliceutil.Unique`, `sliceutil.Flatten`, `sliceutil.First`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/maputil` (`@v0.6.0`): Generic type-safe map operations beyond standard library `maps`.
  - Exports: `maputil.Merge`, `maputil.Filter`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/stringutil` (`@v0.6.0`): Sensitive PII masking (`MaskEmail`, `MaskPhone`), safe truncation, and CSPRNG string generation.
  - Exports: `stringutil.OrDefault`, `stringutil.MaskEmail`, `stringutil.MaskPhone`, `stringutil.TrimAndLower`, `stringutil.Truncate`, `stringutil.RandomAlphanumeric`, `stringutil.RandomSecureString`, `stringutil.RandomStringFromReader`.
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs/timeutil` (`@v0.6.0`): Parametric timezone conversion, day boundary helpers, and business day arithmetic.
  - Exports: `timeutil.NowIn`, `timeutil.FormatIn`, `timeutil.StartOfDay`, `timeutil.EndOfDay`, `timeutil.AddBusinessDays`, `timeutil.BusinessDays`.

## Abeta Go Ecosystem Cross-Reference

`go-libs` is the foundational operational layer of the 4-repository **Abeta Go Ecosystem**:

1. **`go-libs@v0.6.0`** (`github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs`): 41 zero-business-logic foundational Go packages for HTTP/Gin & stdlib `httpmw` middleware, SSE, ETag, loopback CSRF guards, resilience, concurrency, PostgreSQL & embedded SQLite WAL, RBAC, and OpenTelemetry.
   - Docs Portal: https://abeta-dev.github.io/go-libs/
   - GoDoc: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs
2. **`go-fintech-india@v0.5.0`** (`github.com/abeta-dev/go-fintech-india`): Zero-dependency Indian FinTech & statutory compliance engine (`17` domain files: exact `int64` paise `Money` math, deterministic `CalculateGST` intra/inter-state `CGST+SGST`/`IGST` tax-split, statutory `CalculateTDS` section calculator with Section 206AA enforcement, `GSTIN` Mod-36, `PAN`, `Aadhaar` Verhoeff D5, `<100ns` offline `IFSC`/`MICR`, NPCI `UPI` URIs, Razorpay/Cashfree/PhonePe webhooks, Indian `FY`/Advance Tax, MCA Schedule III aging).
   - Docs Portal: https://abeta-dev.github.io/go-fintech-india/
   - GoDoc: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/abeta-dev/go-fintech-india
3. **`go-app-kit@v0.7.0`** (`github.com/abeta-dev/go-app-kit`): **7** enterprise application workflow engines (`outbox`, `pdf`, `notifications`, `audit`, `export` with Brotli/Gzip streaming CSV, zero-leak object `storage` with presigned URLs, and lease-fenced periodic job `scheduler`).
   - Docs Portal: https://abeta-dev.github.io/go-app-kit/
   - GoDoc: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/abeta-dev/go-app-kit
4. **`cloud-native-observability@v0.4.0`** (`github.com/abeta-dev/cloud-native-observability`): OpenTelemetry Collector + LGTM stack, Google SRE multi-window burn-rate SLOs, ArgoCD GitOps, and 3-layer Terraform IaC.
   - Docs Portal: https://abeta-dev.github.io/cloud-native-observability/
   - Repository: https://github.com/abeta-dev/cloud-native-observability
